private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: AlphaFold 3 lineage; added Johnson & Johnson as a third partner alongside Lilly and Novartis. First oncology clinical trials expected by year-end 2026.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: Rentosertib Phase IIa readout in IPF still the field's clearest clinical proof point; now stacking a Lilly licensing pact and a BIO 2026 CNS collaboration with SK Biopharmaceuticals.

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: ARCH/Foresite mega-launch around generative biology; still the largest single debut round in AI-biotech history.

private_watchlist.name: New Limit
private_watchlist.note: Epigenetic reprogramming for longevity (Founders Fund, Lilly Ventures); Retro Biosciences also notable, now valued at $1.8B with an Alzheimer's trial underway.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic
bear_case.description: AI speeds discovery, but most drugs still fail in humans; one Phase IIa success is not a field-wide validation.

bear_case.title: Catalyst-driven volatility
bear_case.description: These stocks trade on announcements; between catalysts they drift and dilute. Both Generate (GENB) and Eikon (EIKN) traded below their Feb 2026 IPO prices shortly after debut.

bear_case.title: Platform-value skepticism
bear_case.description: If pharma can license AI tools cheaply (or build in-house), platform companies may capture less value than valuations imply.

bear_case.title: Rate sensitivity
bear_case.description: Long-duration biotech cash flows are highly sensitive to rates; macro can swamp fundamentals.
